subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should model-call spans change from implicit `INTERNAL` to explicit `CLIENT` for all telemetry exporters, accepting that existing dashboards may need filter updates?
rationale: The implementation and standards support the change, but accepting an exported telemetry classification change remains a maintainer compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept model-only correction
options.body: Merge the narrow model-call change and accept that trace consumers may need to update kind-based filters.

options.title: Preserve legacy classification
options.body: Keep the existing implicit `INTERNAL` kind until a versioned or opt-in telemetry transition is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept model-only correction
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow model-call change and accept that trace consumers may need to update kind-based filters.

likelyOwner.reason: They defined the model-versus-tool scope on the prior PR and have recent history in this service.
